column2: I-Kumkaj iwuphawu lwama-app ezinhlelo zokusebenza zebhizinisi ezibambekayo — isofthiwe ephelele yokuphatha ibhizinisi esebenza kumadivayisi akho. Umkhiqizo ngamunye wakhelwe umsebenzi owodwa: amaphasela, indawo yokudlela, isitolo sokudla, ikhemisi.
Akukho lutho kule khawunta olulinda ifu.
Skrola noma usebenzise amachashazi ukuze weqele phakathi kwezigaba.

Hhayi i-app eyodwa enenkinobho yokushintsha umsebenzi. Umkhiqizo ngamunye uklanywe ngohlobo olulodwa lwekhawunta, ngamagama alowo msebenzi uqobo.

Ukuthengisa, izinhlangothi nencwadi yosuku kubhalwa kudivayisi esekhawunteni yakho — hhayi kuseva oyiqashile.
Konke ukuthengisa, inkokhelo nedokhethi kugcinwa kukhompyutha noma ethebhulethini onayo.
Yifake bese uqala. Akukho ukubhalisa, alikho ikhadi eligciniwe.
Yenza ikhophi yokulondoloza noma nini lapho uthanda. Iyifayela, futhi ingeyakho.
Amakhawunta namathebhulethi engeziwe axhuma nge-Wi-Fi yakho — ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi phakathi.
Ama-app e-Kumkaj awadingi ukuxhumana neseva yethu ukuze asebenze. Nqamula i-inthanethi bese ubuka okushintshayo ekhawunteni.
Izinto eziphuma esitolo, njengerisidi le-WhatsApp, zisadinga i-inthanethi ukuze zifike.
Akukho ukukhokhiswa ngesihlalo, umsebenzisi, itafula, umlethi, iphasela noma idivayisi. Akusona isikhathi sokuhlola.
Khokhela kuphela lokho okusebenzisayo — amanani afanayo kuwo wonke umuntu.
Ifu lihleliwe futhi lingokuzikhethela. Ikhawunta isebenza ngaphandle kwalo.

Uhlu olufanayo lwezilimi eziyi-115 njengawo wonke ama-app e-Kumkaj — isi-Arabhu nesi-Urdu kusuka kwesokudla kuya kwesokunxele. Amagama endabuko angezansi; izibonelo ze-“Ukudla sekulungile” ngesiHindi, isiGujarati, isiTamil, isiBengali, isi-Urdu nesiNgisi:
Injini efanayo yokwakha imibhalo njengama-app, ukuze izinhlamvu ezixhumene nemigqa yesokudla-kuya-kwesokunxele iphume kahle.

Amaphasela · indawo yokudlela · isitolo sokudla · ikhemisi
Ideski lamaphasela — bhuka, faka ilebula, nikela, qedela imali.
Uhlelo lwendawo yokudlela — itafula, ikhishi, ibhili, ukuvalwa kosuku.
Ikhawunta yesitolo sokudla — thengisa, incwadi yezikweletu, isitoko, incwadi yosuku.
Ikhawunta yekhemisi — iqoqo, ukuphelelwa yisikhathi, ibhili, ukuvalwa kosuku.
I-inthanethi ivaliwe — futhi akukho okushintshile ekhawunteni.
Umkhiqizo ngamunye we-Kumkaj une-akhawunti yawo (nefu lawo). Khetha umsebenzi owenzayo — ukungena nokukhokha kuhlala kusayithi yalowo mkhiqizo.

Izinhlelo zefu zonyaka — izinhlobo ezinhlanu ezifanayo zawo wonke umsebenzi (Mahhala unomphela, Steady ₹6 000, Swift ₹14 000, Priority ₹28 000 / ngonyaka ngaphandle kwentela, noma isilinganiso sentengo esenziwe ngokwezifiso). Intela yengezwa lapho ukhokha. Umkhiqizo ngamunye ugcina isitolo sawo ne-akhawunti yawo.
